items.text: The same part of speech is used after pair conjunctions such as 'not only…but also'. There is a preposition followed by gerund(providing)  after  'but  also'.  Therefore,  'not  only'  will  be placed before the preposition 'by'. Hence, 'helped her not only by' is the most appropriate answer.

headings: Sol.293.(a) helped her not only by

items.contextualized_text:
Sol.293.(a) helped her not only by
The same part of speech is used after pair conjunctions such as 'not only…but also'. There is a preposition followed by gerund(providing)  after  'but  also'.  Therefore,  'not  only'  will  be placed before the preposition 'by'. Hence, 'helped her not only by' is the most appropriate answer.
